summary: Wildlife conservation and biodiversity monitoring are the primary focus areas of this project. The beneficiaries include conservationists, researchers, and organizations working in national parks, research universities, and NGOs worldwide. The project operates in various geographic contexts, including remote field deployments and global conservation work. Its impact is to accelerate the review of motion-triggered wildlife camera images, enabling more efficient detection and classification of species. The project addresses the sectors of ecology, conservation, and wildlife monitoring, utilizing deep learning tools and AI for biodiversity conservation.
